batches.name: Tolland County north: Rockville, Tolland, Ellington, Somers, Stafford, Ashford
batches.why: Diocese List of Parishes, March 6, 2026 (norwichdiocese.org/Portals/dioceseofnorwich/CMAdmin/Parishes_CCD9Mar26.pdf): Blessed Sacrament Parish (St. Bernard, Rockville merged with St. Matthew, Tolland; Fr. Ricard; one site blessedsacramentct.org, a Connecting Members site with /Resources/Bulletin), plus single parishes St. Joseph Rockville (Polish; eCatholic 25042 behind a 403, use visit.py), St. Luke Ellington (www.stlukeellington.com redirects to churchofstlukect.com), All Saints Somersville, St. Edward Stafford Springs (LPi 0018000000Qx96BAAR) and St. Philip Ashford (WordPress posts per bulletin). Six parishes, mostly one church each: the typical batch. Closed per the list: Sacred Heart Vernon, St. Joseph Staffordville, St. Jude Willington (GCatholic still lists Staffordville and Willington).

batches.name: Middletown, Cromwell and Portland
batches.why: Diocese List of Parishes, March 6, 2026 (norwichdiocese.org/Portals/dioceseofnorwich/CMAdmin/Parishes_CCD9Mar26.pdf): five Middletown parishes (St. Francis of Assisi, St. Mary of Czestochowa (Polish, eCatholic 5434), St. Pius X (Capuchin friary), and St. John + St. Sebastian, yoked under Fr. Thaikoottathil: check whether they share a bulletin; both listed weebly sites fail TLS), St. John Cromwell (eCatholic 25247, 403 to probe) and St. Mary Portland (eCatholic 5153, 403 to probe). Seven parishes. GCatholic adds Holy Apostles College and Seminary, Cromwell: check for public Mass. Also check Wesleyan University campus Mass, Middletown.

batches.name: Middlesex County south: Durham, East Hampton, Haddam, Killingworth, Chester, Essex, Old Saybrook, Westbrook, Clinton
batches.why: Diocese List of Parishes, March 6, 2026 (norwichdiocese.org/Portals/dioceseofnorwich/CMAdmin/Parishes_CCD9Mar26.pdf): merged parishes Our Lady of Mercy (Notre Dame Durham + St. Colman Middlefield), St. John Paul II (St. Patrick East Hampton + St. Bridget Moodus; LPi), St. Teresa of Calcutta (St. Joseph Chester + Our Lady of Sorrows Essex; LPi 0018000000QbzzxAAB, container 03/0729), St. Pio (St. John Old Saybrook + St. Mark Westbrook), the yoked pair St. Peter Higganum + St. Lawrence Killingworth (Fr. DeCosta; separate sites, both ParishesOnline: check for one bulletin), and St. Mary Clinton. Seven parishes, eleven churches. Also check, from the diocese's Full Group Directory (norwichdiocese.org/Find/Full-Group-Directory, read 2026-11-14): Sacred Heart on the Lake retreat centre, Higganum.

batches.name: Norwich, Norwichtown, Fitchville and the Saint Anne cluster (Baltic, Occum, Taftville)
batches.why: Diocese List of Parishes, March 6, 2026 (norwichdiocese.org/Portals/dioceseofnorwich/CMAdmin/Parishes_CCD9Mar26.pdf): the Cathedral of St. Patrick (GCatholic omits it); St. Joseph (Polish) yoked with Sacred Heart Norwichtown under Msgr. Janik, with the mission St. John, Fitchville (Thursday Mass; GCatholic calls it St. John, Bozrah); St. Mary yoked with Ss. Peter & Paul (jnccfaith.org, 'Joint Norwich Catholic Cluster'); and St. Mary Baltic, St. Joseph Occum and Sacred Heart Taftville, yoked under Fr. Tito, whose sites all redirect to saintannecluster.org (Squarespace, 'Saint Anne's Catholic Community', one /bulletin page): likely one bulletin. Eight parishes. The locator map still puts St. Joseph in the Norwich cluster; the list does not. Also check, from the diocese's Full Group Directory (norwichdiocese.org/Find/Full-Group-Directory, read 2026-11-14): the Holy Family Motherhouse / Academy of the Holy Family chapel, Baltic.

batches.name: New London, Waterford, Fishers Island, Montville and the Lymes
batches.why: Diocese List of Parishes, March 6, 2026 (norwichdiocese.org/Portals/dioceseofnorwich/CMAdmin/Parishes_CCD9Mar26.pdf): St. Brendan the Navigator Parish (St. Joseph and St. Mary Star of the Sea New London, St. Paul Waterford, Our Lady of Grace Fishers Island NY; sbnccct.com, LPi 0018000000QxAEWAA3: check whether Fishers Island prints its own), Divine Mercy Parish (St. John Uncasville, Our Lady of Perpetual Help Quaker Hill, Our Lady of the Lakes Oakdale), St. Agnes Niantic yoked with St. Matthias East Lyme (ParishesOnline org st-agnes-and-st-matthias-catholic-church: one bulletin likely) with the summer St. Francis Chapel, Crescent Beach, and Christ the King Old Lyme. Five parishes, many churches. Also check, from the diocese's Full Group Directory (norwichdiocese.org/Find/Full-Group-Directory, read 2026-11-14): the U.S. Coast Guard Academy chapel, New London (campus Mass).

batches.why: Diocese List of Parishes, March 6, 2026 (norwichdiocese.org/Portals/dioceseofnorwich/CMAdmin/Parishes_CCD9Mar26.pdf): the Groton yoked parishes (Sacred Heart, St. Mary Mother of the Redeemer, Our Lady of Lourdes Gales Ferry; Fr. batches.name: Windham County northeast: Putnam, Thompson, Pomfret, Brooklyn, Danielson, Plainfield
batches.why: Diocese List of Parishes, March 6, 2026 (norwichdiocese.org/Portals/dioceseofnorwich/CMAdmin/Parishes_CCD9Mar26.pdf): St. Therese of Lisieux Parish (St. Mary Putnam, Most Holy Trinity Pomfret, St. Joseph North Grosvenordale, St. Stephen Quinebaug; LPi 0018000000Qc2DZAAZ), Our Lady of La Salette Brooklyn with its mission Our Lady of Lourdes Hampton, St. James Danielson and St. Andre Bessette Parish (St. John Plainfield, All Hallows Moosup, St. Augustine Canterbury). Four parishes but eleven churches and seven closed churches the list names (Ballouville, Dayville, East Killingly, Rogers, Sterling, Wauregan, West Thompson): fewer parishes for that reason. Also check, from the diocese's Full Group Directory (norwichdiocese.org/Find/Full-Group-Directory, read 2026-11-14): the Marian Fathers, Thompson, and the Daughters of the Holy Spirit and Immaculate Conception convents, Putnam (public Mass or private chapels).

batches.name: Willimantic, Coventry, Storrs, Columbia, Hebron, Bolton, Colchester, Lebanon
batches.why: Diocese List of Parishes, March 6, 2026 (norwichdiocese.org/Portals/dioceseofnorwich/CMAdmin/Parishes_CCD9Mar26.pdf): Corpus Christi Parish (St. Joseph and St. Mary Willimantic, Sagrado Corazon Windham; catholicwindham.org, Wix PDFs), Our Lady Queen of Peace (St. Mary Coventry + St. Thomas Aquinas Storrs, the UConn church; both listed domains are dead), Good Shepherd Parish (St. Columba Columbia + Holy Family Hebron; ParishesOnline) yoked with St. Maurice Bolton under Fr. Phillippino: check whether Bolton shares the bulletin; and Guardian Angels Parish (St. Andrew Colchester + St. Francis Lebanon; site answers 404). Five parishes. Closed: St. Joseph Eagleville, St. Margaret Scotland.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic churches in the territory
batches.why: GCatholic lists three churches of other jurisdictions: St. Mary (Ukrainian), Colchester; Protection of the BVM (Ukrainian), Willimantic; St. Ann (Melkite), Waterford. The diocesan list has none of them. Expected: other-jurisdiction exclusions (Ukrainian Eparchy of Stamford, Melkite Eparchy of Newton).
